## RecordFieldSdk type

The SDK type of one record field: the SDK type of its value type, whether or not the field is optional.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type RecordFieldSdk<Field> =
  Field extends OptionalField<infer Sdk> ? Sdk : Field extends ValueType<infer Sdk> ? Sdk : never
```
